metadata.title: Biunital Lie Semiheaps and Lie Triple Systems
metadata.abstract: We examine the differential geometry of Lie semiheaps that admit biunital elements. Open Ol'shanskii semigroups, which appear widely across causal geometry and harmonic analysis, provide a large class of examples. It is shown that the subset of biunits is a smoothly embedded Lie subheap. Moreover, there is a canonical Lie triple algebroid associated with any proper biunital Lie semiheap. That is, there is a vector bundle over the manifold of biunits that comes equipped with a ternary bracket that satisfies the axioms of a Lie triple system together with a compatible `higher' anchor map. Although every Lie triple algebroid associated with a proper biunital Lie semiheap is trivialisable, it is not canonically so, unlike the case of the tangent bundle of a Lie group. As concrete examples, we examine the Lie semiheap of real $n\times n$ matrices, and the conformal causal Lie semiheap associated with the Lie group $\mathrm{SU}(2,2)$, which is a double cover of the conformal group of Minkowski spacetime, and the future-directed light cone.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 作者研究具有双单位元素的Lie semiheap，证明双单位子集为光滑嵌入Lie subheap，并为proper biunital情形构造典范Lie triple algebroid：双单位流形上的向量丛配三元括号及相容高阶anchor。
analysis.breakthrough: 把Lie群的微分几何类比推广到三元代数结构，实例含实矩阵和SU(2,2)相关共形因果结构。
analysis.limitations: 相关向量丛虽可平凡化却非典范平凡化；proper条件及具体三元公理不能省略，不能当作普通Lie algebroid的无条件同义物。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第15页明确Gemini3.6 Flash协助proofs与examples的conceptualisation，作者验证全部结果。可记录证明辅助与探索，但没有具体命名核心构造或研究路线的模型归因，不凭泛称构思标ideas；作者验证不算AI核查。
